The Mutasarrifate of Jerusalem, or Sanjak of Jerusalem, included Jerusalem, Jaffa, Hebron, Beersheba, and Gaza, and along with the sanjaks of Nablus and Acre to the north, they were districts that formed the geographic REGION known as Palestine. Also continued to be called Eretz Israel (Land of Israel) by Jews, Bilad al-sham (greater Syria) by Arabs and Muslims, and Holy Land by Christians.
